title: Nuclear assets of the 29th Guards Missile Division near Irkutsk

tellings.quote: As it so happens, we know that the 29th Guards Missile Division is and long has been a live nuclear-armed mobile ICBM force in Irkutsk.

plain: Michels says that the 29th Guards Missile Division, a Russian unit near Irkutsk in Siberia, "is and long has been" a live force of mobile, nuclear-armed long-range missiles. He says it himself while discussing a man named Stephen Pearson, in an episode about strange three-fingered bodies from Peru, and he does not spell out how the missiles tie into the rest of the story.
